scope: Independent fixed-criterion reading of literal default body only. Exposed development controls, not novel blind holdouts.

exposure.limitation: Both reader and parent saw the original public endpoint arrays. This is not a pristine blind BASIC-first pass. Only literal body facts count; endpoint-only moves, numeric causality and private evidence receive no credit.
